items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The last time we played together was at the, Newport News. We had three trombone players. We had Jack Teagarden, Kid Ory and myself, we played together on the same stand.

ctx.x: He sure was but he didn't get angry about it. I mean it's clean fun, doing that kind of thing.
What was your impression of Kid Ory?

Kid Ory? I haven't been around him so many times. The last time we played together was at the, Newport News. We had three trombone players. We had Jack Teagarden, Kid Ory and myself, we played together on the same stand.
